jurisdictions.name: US Federal
jurisdictions.disclosure: FRE 702 (2023): preponderance standard; FRE 707 withdrawn (2026); discovery under FRCP 16/26
jurisdictions.reliability: Daubert four-factor test; PCAST validity-as-applied distinction
jurisdictions.provenance: FRE 901(b)(9) authentication; no AI-specific provenance rule

jurisdictions.name: US States (Frye)
jurisdictions.disclosure: Case-by-case discovery orders (Pickett, Arteaga, Miles); no uniform standard
jurisdictions.reliability: Frye general acceptance in relevant forensic community (Puloka)
jurisdictions.provenance: State authentication rules; no AI-specific requirements

jurisdictions.name: European Union
jurisdictions.disclosure: AI Act Annex IV documentation; Art. 12 logging; Art. 13 transparency
jurisdictions.reliability: Arts. 9-15 high-risk requirements (risk mgmt., accuracy, robustness)
jurisdictions.provenance: LED Art. 11 automated processing limits; GDPR Art. 22

jurisdictions.name: United Kingdom
jurisdictions.disclosure: Common-law presumption of computer reliability under review post-Horizon
jurisdictions.reliability: No AI-specific test; expert evidence governed by CrimPR Part 19

jurisdictions.name: India
jurisdictions.disclosure: BSA 2023 s.63 two-part certificate with hash value
jurisdictions.reliability: Certificate proves integrity, not authenticity or correctness
jurisdictions.provenance: Hash-based, but deepfakes with valid hashes can satisfy

jurisdictions.name: Canada
jurisdictions.disclosure: Directive on Automated Decision-Making: Algorithmic Impact Assessment
jurisdictions.reliability: Four impact levels with scaled peer review and explanation

jurisdictions.name: Council of Europe
jurisdictions.disclosure: Framework Convention on AI (CETS 225); CEPEJ Ethical Charter
